cases.input: Okay so um let me give you a quick update on where we are with the migration. We moved the user service over to the new cluster on Monday, and uh, most things went fine, but the billing jobs started failing on Tuesday night because the cron schedule was still pointing at the old database host. I mean, it was the old replica, not the primary. We fixed the config on Wednesday morning and reran the jobs, so customers should not see any missing invoices, but I want someone to double check the totals for the twelfth and the thirteenth just to be safe. The other thing is the dashboard is still slow, like it takes around eight seconds to load the monthly report, and I think it's because we never added the index on the created at column. So yeah, can we add that index this week, and maybe also set up an alert for failed cron jobs so this doesn't happen again?
cases.output: Let me give you a quick update on where we are with the migration. We moved the user service over to the new cluster on Monday, and most things went fine, but the billing jobs started failing on Tuesday night because the cron schedule was still pointing at the old replica. We fixed the config on Wednesday morning and reran the jobs, so customers should not see any missing invoices, but I want someone to double check the totals for the twelfth and the thirteenth just to be safe. The other thing is the dashboard is still slow: it takes around eight seconds to load the monthly report, and I think it's because we never added the index on the created_at column. Can we add that index this week, and maybe also set up an alert for failed cron jobs so this doesn't happen again?
